items.title: Bali travel trio - search with categories, explore, favourites
items.description: Three light travel screens: 'Bali, Indonesia' search with categories (Mountains, Beach, Waterfall, Desert) and Trending 'Bromo and Malang $200'; 'Explore' with a map card and 128 places (Kawah Ijen $200, Nusa Penida $100); 'Favorites' list (Kawah Ijen, Nusa Penida, Sempoh Snow $130, Bromo Sunrise). A search-to-favourites loop.

items.title: Badminton tournament - splash poster, leagues, availability
items.description: A 'BADMINTON TOURNAMENT' poster ($10 early registration, 16th July, USA) beside the app home (Micheal Watsonn, Upcoming Events, Male/Female League photo cards) and an 'Availability' screen with a month grid, V. Chu/Lee Zh score rows and a Martin Tyler voice note. Badminton, not tennis.

items.title: Pastel banking marketing wall - matchmaker, money, journey
items.description: Five frosted pastel screens: 'Meet Your AI Matchmaker' photo card, 'Welcome Back' (Continue with Email/Google/Apple), 'Let's Get started', 'Take Control of Your Money' coin-wallet illustration, and 'Your Next Journey Begins Right Here Today' clouds with a gift tile. A soft banking onboarding wall.

items.title: In-hand routine app - 'Hello Jhone' with a daily routine list
items.description: A hand holds a phone over a teal field: 'Hello Jhone' week strip, a mint 'Make today count' card with Add New Habit, and a Daily routine list (Meditate 14 min, Drink water, Go for a walk, Read a Book). A habits/routine home, not laundry.

items.title: Yolk savings onboarding - ten cream screens with a chick mascot
items.description: Ten cream onboarding screens for 'Yolk' with a line-drawn chick: 'What should we call you?', 'What's your goal amount?', 'Enter your code', 'Connect your world' (bank list), 'Here's what Yolk saved for you', 'Pick your plan' ($0 / $6.99), 'Not ready for $200/yr? You're in, Eleanor'. A savings-app onboarding sheet.

items.title: Campus Laundry - Wash & Fold detail beside the provider sheet
items.description: Two panels: 'Wash & Fold From ₦5,000' over folded-towel photos with About this service, and the Campus Laundry provider card (Verified, Price & Service, Service Options). The service-detail half of the Campus Laundry flow also in IMG-0376/0377/0378.

items.title: Hand-held step counter - 9,567 of 10,000 steps
items.description: A hand in a kitchen holds a phone showing a steps screen: week bars, a huge '9,567 / 10,000 Steps', 7.55 km, 793 kCal, Share, and a 'Cool side of X - walk it off' row. A pedometer home, not finance.

items.title: Music onboarding - 'Pick your favorite artists' selection sheet
items.description: A white sheet over a dark screen: 'Pick your favorite artists - We'll use them to personalize your mixes' with a search field and a grid (J. Cole, Drake, NewJeans, Baby Keem, Joji, 2hollis - several ticked green) and a black 'Confirm selection'. An artist-picking step, not avatars.

items.title: Ember onboarding - 'Experience Your World, in Pictures' in an editor
items.description: Light and dark 'Ember' splash/onboarding pairs ('Experience Your World, in Pictures.' with spaceship line art, Continue with Apple) laid out inside a design-editor canvas with a toolbar below. An onboarding presented as a design file.

items.title: 'Buy a Gift' referral rewards on a dark panel
items.description: A dark cropped screen: share icons (link, Messages, Instagram, WhatsApp), a glowing gift-tile card, 'Buy a Gift - Give the g... for 1 year f...' and a 'Referral Rewards' heading. A gifting/referral moment.

items.title: Agent wallet profile - $1,000.21 balance in a glowing orb
items.description: A dark profile: a large pearl orb reading 'Balance $1,000.21, Total earn +$0.21' over a horizon glow, Deposit/Withdraw rows and 'Agents 2 active' with a dial button. A minimal agent-economy wallet.

items.title: Dark music library - shelves, recently added and a live player
items.description: A dark 'Library': three album tiles, rows (Playlists, Artists, Albums, Songs, Downloaded), 'Recently Added' photo cards (Ex-Single, Princesss) and a now-playing bar 'Gravity - Steve Aoki, Fly Oaks & SACHA'. A complete library home.

items.title: Audiobook-style player - 'I Love My Computer' with tracklist
items.description: A dark player for 'I Love My Computer - Ninajirachi, Dance 2026' with collage cover art, shuffle/Play/add buttons, a numbered tracklist (London Song, iPod Touch, F**k My Computer, CSIRAC) and a Home/New/Radio/Library nav. An album player with queue.

items.title: 'Heaven' by Ryan Leahan - full-bleed night-street player
items.description: A full-bleed player over a blurred night-street photo: 'Heaven - Ryan Leahan', a squiggle waveform at 0:46/-2:34, big pause controls and 'Playing from Discovery Station'. A photographic now-playing screen.

items.title: Calendar pitch - headline band above a dense January grid
items.description: A marketing frame: red calendar icon and 'Your calendar, already in it - Your meetings sit between your tasks...' headline over a dark January 2027 month grid (42 events, 2 tasks) packed with coloured event chips. A calendar product pitch.

items.title: TableMate restaurant app - a twelve-screen sheet
items.description: Twelve screens of 'TableMate': black splash, 'Good Food Is Better Together' photo hero, Create your account, Welcome Back login, 'What are we eating tonight?', 'Meet the hosts', table pages and 'Invite friends' flows. A restaurant/table-sharing sheet, not a social contact sheet.

items.title: Step-games advert grid - chartreuse comic-style promo panels
items.description: Six chartreuse promo panels: 'Turn Your Daily Steps Into Games', 'Invite & Challenge Your Friends' (56,132 steps Today), 'Winner gets treated to dinner!', 'Build streaks, see progress' (395,908), 'Workout stats worth showing off', 'Your steps never looked this good' (2.15 km map). A comic-styled fitness marketing grid, not a budget app.

items.title: Light crypto portfolio - $386,006.84 with token rows
items.description: A light wallet card: 'X @wallet 2', Total Value $386,006.84 (+1.49%), an 'Exclusive Limited-Time Offer' banner and a Portfolio list with All/Tokens/DeFi/Cash tabs (Bitcoin $75,158.75, Ethereum $57,651.44, Solana $20,148.73, XRP $17,846.78) beside a floating rail. A portfolio home.

items.title: Co—Star astrology - moon poster over a phone of daily cards
items.description: A stippled moon-and-constellation poster framing a phone showing cream 'Co—Star' cards ('Your day at a glance', 'Who do you think you are?', 'Don't be a dick.'). An astrology brand visual, not a sleep tracker.

items.title: TableMate - 'Invite friends' to a table of four
items.description: A tilted phone: host banner ('Rophy - Host. You'll manage this table and invite everyone'), a dashed '+ Invite friends' button, '4 people at the table' avatar row and a black 'Create table' CTA. The table-creation step of TableMate.

items.title: Sound Intelligence stats beside the 'Endless Vibes' player
items.description: Two dark screens of one music app: 'Sound Intelligence' (Listening Time 18:42, Genre Distribution dot bars) and the full-bleed 'Featured Sounds - ENDLESS VIBES' player. The same product as IMG-0454.

items.title: Nara music-social promo - 'Come For The Vibe, Stay for The People'
items.description: An orange promo with three tilted dark screens: 'Come For The Vibe Stay for The People' illustrated card, the Nara home (story circles, Flora post with photo grid, 25k followers) and a Flora profile (Following/Message, photo wall). A music-social marketing panel.

items.title: Language learning - three feature slides on one card template
items.description: Three white feature slides sharing a template: 'Learn watching Netflix & YouTube' (video card with red play badges), 'Understand every word in context' (Amébie film still with French subtitle), 'Turn input into speaking' (French chat bubbles), each with Save words/Any video/Talk with AI and Get Started/Log In. A language-app pitch.

items.title: Pool care app - water dial, February report and analysis history
items.description: Three pastel pool-maintenance screens: 'Effortless Pool Care Made Simple' (Nikola Dobric) with a 25°C water dial and Pump/Air/Water tiles, 'Report February 2028' (Filtration time slider, Chemicals, pH injection, Disinfection) and 'Analysis' history (0.27 ppm, 0 ppm, 7.6 pH, 210 ppm). A pool-care suite, not wellness.
